ITEM 1 | Golden-tan baked dough crust along the outer edges of two rectangular slices, dry and slightly bready with light browning, about 1.5 cm wide at the edge, with a firm, cracker-like texture at the top-right slice edges | 35
ITEM 2 | Thin, glossy red-orange tomato sauce visible between cheese patches and at the slice edges, moist with a slight sheen, spreading flat across the dough | 15
ITEM 3 | Melted white-to-pale-yellow cheese covering the slices in irregular blobs, with darker brown blistered and browned spots, sagging and soft with a slight sheen, about 1 cm thick | 50
